alt: 老師只示範把長方形對半摺，孩子理解後，就能把圓形、三角形和正方形也各自對摺。
scene_prompt: 舉一反三 means understanding one example and independently applying its principle to other related cases. Modern elementary classroom craft table. At left a teacher demonstrates exactly ONE example: folding a rectangular paper sheet in HALF, visibly matching its two edges. At right a thoughtful child independently applies that same halving principle to THREE DIFFERENT shapes laid out clearly: a circle folded into a semicircle, an equilateral triangle folded along its symmetry line, and a square folded diagonally. Same muted pastel paper palette, clear creases and matched halves, delighted realization. A tiny outlined lightbulb thought symbol may show understanding, but no text, letters, numerals, multiplication signs, labels or arithmetic. Show transfer to new shapes, not copying the identical rectangle.
